correctness.rationale: Each residue modulo k is a free t-dimensional bi-infinite recurrence kernel. The coordinate-evaluation dual is a Laurent-polynomial quotient by a binomial recurrence ideal; the local binomial difference has exact vanishing order equal to the largest characteristic-prime power dividing the sampling step. Each sampled progression therefore has the minimum of its number of sites and the ceiling of time divided by that prime power as its rank. The R independent residue classes sum to the claimed rank and give the exact first surjective time. Full-target affine fibers exist by surjectivity. Standalone recurrence Gaussian elimination verified 4,326 examples; finite tests do not justify infinite quantifiers.

The theorem determines all intermediate affine fiber-pattern counts for every target and a sharp first universal time, not just existence or a parameter substitution. The p-adic resonance causes unbounded separation-dependent delays at fixed m while coprime spacings retain a constant horizon. Such complete algebraic benchmarks can test quantitative information transport and finite-field reconstruction.
